主要内容: On June 3, 2019, GTC, Inc., a subsidiary of Geospace Technologies Corporation, entered into a purchase and sale contract with Harmony Public Schools, a Texas non-profit corporation, to sell all real property located at 7334-7340 Gessner Road, Houston, Texas, for $8,600,000. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of the Company’s fiscal year ending September 30, 2019, subject to due diligence completion.
